name: Paper Marker
tagline: Huge kinetic type on paper, marker notes that draw themselves, and hard switches to black.
description: Hand-made explainer style for product launches and one-idea pitches. Slamming heavy type on a warm paper canvas, red-pen arrows and circles that draw on, a yellow highlighter swipe, and hard cuts between paper and ink-black every 1.5–2 seconds.

display.usage: Kinetic headlines 190–250px, tracking -0.03em, two short lines max

body.usage: Marker notes, tags and CTA 64–80px, slightly rotated

transitions: hard cut between paper and ink-black (no fade)
no transitions inside a scene; everything enters on beats
textAnimations: line slam: y 90 + scale 1.18 → rest, 0.45s, 0.16s stagger
highlighter bar scaleX 0→1 behind one word, text flips to ink
SVG marker strokes draw on with pathLength=1 dashoffset 1→0
tags stamp in with scale 1.5 and a slight rotation

rhythm.notes: A new idea every 1.5–2s. Alternate paper and black scenes; each scene gets one slam plus one or two marker marks.

guide:
- Paper #f4efe4 with a faint dot grain; ink scenes are #141210. Cut hard between them, never crossfade.
- One sentence per scene, split into two lines of heavy type (Archivo Black 190–250px). Lines slam in with expo.out, 0.16s apart.
- Marker marks are SVG paths with pathLength="1" and stroke-dasharray 1; animate strokeDashoffset 1→0 with power2.inOut in 0.3–0.55s. Red pen for arrows and circles, yellow for highlighter and underlines.
- Handwritten notes (Caveat 64–80px) name concrete numbers: "3,204 this year", "Software · $1,180".
- Name what the product learns or does, never the abstraction. End on the wordmark with a highlighter underline and a blue-pen URL.
